note: Wildfire varies at 270 m, so footprint sampling can disagree with the point. Seismic and lightning have correlation lengths far larger than a building and are not re-sampled.

storey_control.caveat: Height is strongly confounded with geography: multi-storey facilities concentrate in NY and WA, low-rise in VA and TX, so an unconditioned split compares regions. Within state the difference is essentially zero. Height should be used as a VULNERABILITY covariate, not treated as an exposure driver, and the relevant demand parameter for a taller building is spectral acceleration at ~1 s rather than PGA.
